name: Izanami
shortBackstory: Izanami is the mountain-wind breaker — the Tengu-source whose judgment shatters masks that hide corruption behind false purity.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Izanami was born from the mountain wind that strips masks. He is the breaker who shatters false purity. Ancient humans saw him as the Tengu — but they saw the discipline and missed the purpose. Izanami's breaking is not violence; it is exposure.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Kami, Izanami tests whether purity is real or performed. He shatters the masks that conceal corruption. The other deities fear his judgment because his breaking does not care about rank or sacred office.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Mythos Gate wounded Izanami by making his masks meaningless. The Hollow removed the faces behind the masks — so when Izanami shattered a mask, there was nothing beneath it. His shrine-tide judgment found emptiness where truth should have been.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In the Kami Mirror Tempest, Izanami shatters corrupted shrine defenses. His mountain-wind maul cracks open false purity. But some masks are empty — there is nothing behind them to expose.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Izanami's flaw is that he has never believed in masks, even when they protect. The Hollow teaches him that some masks are not deception but shelter, and the breaker who shatters all shelters may leave the faction exposed.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
human_echo: Izanami's Yomi descent was the real creation of death; her decayed form was the truth behind Yomi mythology
